1.t: Glorify the name of thy Guardian-Lord Most High,

2.t: Who hath created, and further, given order and proportion;

3.t: Who hath ordained laws. And granted guidance;

4.t: And Who bringeth out the (green and luscious) pasture,

5.t: And then doth make it (but) swarthy stubble.

6.t: By degrees shall We teach thee to declare (the Message), so thou shalt not forget,

7.t: Except as Allah wills: For He knoweth what is manifest and what is hidden.

8.t: And We will make it easy for thee (to follow) the simple (Path).

9.t: Therefore give admonition in case the admonition profits (the hearer).

10.t: The admonition will be received by those who fear (Allah):

11.t: But it will be avoided by those most unfortunate ones,

12.t: Who will enter the Great Fire,

13.t: In which they will then neither die nor live.

14.t: But those will prosper who purify themselves,

15.t: And glorify the name of their Guardian-Lord, and (lift their hearts) in prayer.

16.t: Nay (behold), ye prefer the life of this world;

17.t: But the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

18.t: And this is in the Books of the earliest (Revelation),-

19.t: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
